description: This file defines the AppTheme class which encapsulates color schemes and theme data for light and dark modes in a Flutter application. It contains theme constants, color scheme configurations, and theme data getters to provide consistent styling across the app.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A class that provides theme data and color schemes for the app's light and dark modes.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData object configured for light mode, including color scheme and component styles.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData object configured for dark mode, including color scheme and component styles.
